name: button
description: Triggers an action when pressed with a mouse, touch or keyboard. Use primary for the one main action in a view, secondary or ghost for the rest, danger for destructive actions. For navigation use a link instead.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight: primary for the main action, secondary for other actions, ghost for low-emphasis actions in toolbars, danger for destructive actions.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Called on press from mouse, touch, Enter or Space. Use instead of onClick.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Prevents presses and dims the button.

props.name: type
props.description: Form behaviour, as on a native button.

props.name: children
props.description: The label, optionally with an icon.
